title: Olink® Target 96 Part 1/3: Incubation
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the required protocol parameters in the Opentrons interface as prompted.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if the files are compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the custom labware JSON files to upload.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol Python file (with a .py extension) to the Opentrons App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the physical deck of the robot according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the calibration routine in the Opentrons App (refer to support articles for tips).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the ‘Run’ button in the Opentrons App to start the incubation protocol.
